name: review
description: Review and quality plugin. Spawns parallel specialist reviewers (code quality, security, accessibility) and produces a unified, deduplicated, prioritized findings report -- no code changes, findings only.

clean.description: Detect and flag AI-generated noise in code comments, docstrings, and prose

security.description: Security-focused review with >80% confidence threshold and mandatory exploitation chains

review.description: Full parallel review -- spawns code quality, security, and accessibility specialists, deduplicates findings, produces unified report

a11y.description: WCAG 2.1/2.2 accessibility audit with live browser verification or static analysis fallback

help.description: Interactive tour of review capabilities — detects open PRs, existing reports, and Playwright MCP availability
